thread:
Alex M.: FYI — security advisory CVE-2026-1423 affecting our default Dedicated AMI (r-2025-09). Local privilege escalation in upstream kernel backport. Impact: Dedicated and Redwood Private when using our default AMI. Hosted API unaffected.

Alex M.: Immediate actions (TL;DR):
• SRE: schedule rolling reboots and drain (no full outage expected).
• Infra: rebuild AMI with patched kernel and publish new AMI tag.
• Customer Success: notify Private customers with remediation steps.

Alex M.: Details & commands (internal runbook -> https://internal.redwood/sec/advisories/CVE-2026-1423):
```
# verify kernel on host
uname -r
# quick patch (Amazon Linux/Centos-ish)
sudo yum update -y kernel
sudo reboot
# packer AMI rebuild (example)
packer build -var 'ami_tag=security/2026-1423' infra/packer/redwood-ami.json
```

Priya S.: What's the rollout window? will we need to take capacity out manually? :eyes:

Alex M.: Plan is rolling drains across pools, 15m drain per host, automated via svc-drain job. No full-region outage expected. We'll start low-traffic pools first and monitor latency for 2 hours.

Marcus L.: I'll own the AMI rebuild + smoke tests. ETA: end of day. I'll push a canary AMI and tag it `r-2025-09-sec2026-1423`.

Tara O.: For Private/on-prem customers — do we have a short remediation guide we can paste into support tickets?

Alex M.: Yes, Customer Success template in the runbook + CLI steps. Copy/paste: `sudo yum update -y kernel && reboot` and link to advisory. Also include AMI tags for those using Redwood-managed images.

Marcus L.: One question: do any of our GPU packages need rebuilds with the kernel bump? I saw some kernel headers pinned in the CI images.

Alex M.: Good call. Marcus, please validate driver compatibility in the canary and notify eng-ml if we need a driver rebuild. If driver rebuild needed, we'll hold canary until it's green.

Tara O.: Rollback plan? If the patched kernel causes regressions, what do SREs do?

Alex M.: Rollback = reprovision hosts with prior AMI tag `r-2025-09` (no config drift). Runbook section "Rollback -> AMI swap" has the commands. Also: pin model-serving to fallback variant for 1h while we validate.

ops-automation: Patch job kicked off for pool `d-prod-1` (job_id: `0xabc123`). Monitoring phase initiated.

deploy-bot: Maintenance scheduled for pool `d-prod-1` at 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z (rolling, no region-wide outage).

Priya S.: I'll coordinate CS notification and post the customer template to #customer-success after Marcus confirms AMI tag.

Marcus L.: Canary AMI built and smoke tests passing. Tag: `r-2025-09-sec2026-1423`. Kicking off staged rollout now.

Tara O.: Thanks — I'm prepping the support ticket batch and outbound email template.

Alex M.: Thanks everyone. If you see anything anomalous during the rollout, @alex.m escalate to pager and we'll pause rolling jobs. :thumbsup:
